Chiefs vs Bills DraftKings Showdown Picks: Thursday Night Football NFL DFS Captains, Projections and Sim Plays

DraftKings Showdown · Thursday Night Football, November 26 · NFL Week 12 · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 24, 12:56 PM ET

Emmett Johnson has the highest SPAGS projection in the Chiefs at Bills DraftKings Showdown: 21.4 points at $9,400 FLEX, 32.1 at captain for $14,100. Across 10,000 simulations Johnson holds 72% of the winning-lineup credit. Josh Allen holds the most, at 73%. The case against Johnson is his range, not his role: a simulated floor of 7.2 points at a $9,400 FLEX salary, in a game with a 47.5-point total.

He also has the largest captain share: 30.6% of the simulated winning-lineup credit comes with Johnson at captain. Josh Allen is the next captain in line, at 16.8%. The model has him running 6.2 times.

Buffalo is a 3-point favorite, and the implied totals are 25.25 for the Bills and 22.25 for the Chiefs.

Behind Johnson and Allen, the next projections are James Cook III (18.3, $9,800), Patrick Mahomes (18.1, $10,000) and Travis Kelce (11.9, $7,800).

Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 24, 12:56 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup and captain credit come from 10,000 simulations of the Showdown contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th. Showdown lineups use one captain, who scores 1.5x at 1.5x salary, and five FLEX players.

Chris Spags' latest NFL DFS breakdown on the Splash Play NFL channel.

TNF Showdown captain picks: who the sim wins with

Captain: Emmett Johnson, KC RB ($9,400 FLEX / $14,100 CPT)

Emmett Johnson holds 30.6% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain, more than any other player in this game. At captain he costs $14,100 and the 21.4-point SPAGS model projection becomes 32.1 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 12.3 carries and 2.9 targets. Across 10,000 simulations Johnson averaged 21.4 points with a simulated floor of 7.2 and a ceiling of 41.8. He holds 72% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 30.6% as the captain and 41.3% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Josh Allen, BUF QB ($11,000 FLEX / $16,500 CPT)

Josh Allen holds 16.8% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $16,500 and the 20.8-point SPAGS model projection becomes 31.1 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model includes 6.2 rushing attempts. Across 10,000 simulations Allen averaged 20.7 points with a simulated floor of 11.4 and a ceiling of 37.8. He holds 73% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 16.8% as the captain and 56.5% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: James Cook III, BUF RB ($9,800 FLEX / $14,700 CPT)

James Cook III holds 15.9% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $14,700 and the 18.3-point SPAGS model projection becomes 27.4 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 20.7 carries and 2.5 targets. Across 10,000 simulations Cook averaged 18.3 points with a simulated floor of 6.4 and a ceiling of 35.5. He holds 62% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 15.9% as the captain and 46.0% in a FLEX spot.

Top FLEX projections for Chiefs vs Bills

Patrick Mahomes, KC QB ($10,000 FLEX / $15,000 CPT)

Patrick Mahomes carries the 4th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 18.1 DraftKings points for a $10,000 FLEX salary ($15,000 at captain). The model includes 3.0 rushing attempts. Across 10,000 simulations Mahomes averaged 18.2 points with a simulated floor of 10.7 and a ceiling of 34.4. He holds 65% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 10.0% as the captain and 54.9% in a FLEX spot.

Travis Kelce, KC TE ($7,800 FLEX / $11,700 CPT)

Travis Kelce carries the 5th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 11.9 DraftKings points for a $7,800 FLEX salary ($11,700 at captain). The model gives him 6.3 targets on 26.0 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Kelce averaged 11.8 points with a simulated floor of 2.6 and a ceiling of 26.2. He holds 33% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 5.0% as the captain and 28.1% in a FLEX spot.

DJ Moore carries the 6th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 11.1 DraftKings points for an $8,600 FLEX salary ($12,900 at captain). The model gives him 4.8 targets on 15.0 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Rice averaged 11.1 points with a simulated floor of 3.0 and a ceiling of 26.2. He holds 27% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 4.1% as the captain and 22.4% in a FLEX spot.

Showdown value plays at $5,000 and under

Value: Dawson Knox, BUF TE ($3,200 FLEX / $4,800 CPT)

Dawson Knox projects for 6.3 DraftKings points at a $3,200 FLEX salary, 1.96 projected points per $1,000. The model gives him 2.8 targets on 14.0 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Knox averaged 6.3 points with a simulated floor of 0.0 and a ceiling of 21.2. He holds 23% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 2.6% as the captain and 20.2% in a FLEX spot.

Value: Keon Coleman, BUF WR ($3,800 FLEX / $5,700 CPT)

Keon Coleman projects for 7.0 DraftKings points at a $3,800 FLEX salary, 1.85 projected points per $1,000. The model gives him 3.7 targets on 15.7 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Coleman averaged 6.9 points with a simulated floor of -0.2 and a ceiling of 19.0. He holds 21% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 1.8% as the captain and 19.5% in a FLEX spot.

Chiefs vs Bills DraftKings Showdown FAQ

Who is the best captain for the Chiefs vs Bills DraftKings Showdown?

Emmett Johnson holds the largest captain share of simulated winning lineups at 30.6%, ahead of Josh Allen (16.8%) and James Cook III (15.9%), across 10,000 simulations.

What is the best DraftKings Showdown lineup for Chiefs vs Bills?

Build around Emmett Johnson at captain with Josh Allen, James Cook III and Patrick Mahomes at FLEX. That is the core of the lineup that won the most simulations in Chris Spags' pool (27 of 10,000 simulated contests), and it leaves $5,100 for the last two FLEX spots.

Who has the highest projection in Chiefs vs Bills DraftKings Showdown?

Emmett Johnson leads the SPAGS model at 21.4 DraftKings points for $9,400 at FLEX, or 32.1 points at captain for $14,100.

What are the DraftKings salaries for Chiefs vs Bills Showdown?

Josh Allen is the most expensive player at $11,000 FLEX and $16,500 at captain. All 30 players with a SPAGS projection are listed above with FLEX salary, captain salary and projection.

What are the best value plays in Chiefs vs Bills DraftKings Showdown?

At $5,000 and under, the best projected points per $1,000 belong to Dawson Knox (6.3 points at $3,200), Keon Coleman (7.0 points at $3,800) and Tyler Bass (8.7 points at $5,000).

What is the Chiefs vs Bills spread and total?

The Bills are a 3-point favorite in a game totaled at 47.5, with implied team totals of 25.25 for the Bills and 22.25 for the Chiefs.
